consigna: Give someone a piece of difficult professional feedback, in a sustained turn of at least ten minutes — with a person, or written as a dialogue.
requisitos: A summary of the situation with the conclusion first (week 41)
Eight phrasal verbs, no Latinate substitutes (week 43)
If spoken: one repair out loud (week 45)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread your corrected texts from weeks 41–47, plus the three lines from Survival Week. Write down the correction that appeared most often.
*Wed (5 min).* Write one paragraph that carries a summary, a hedge and a phrasal verb in three consecutive sentences.
*Fri (5 min).* Record 90 seconds giving feedback you have actually been avoiding.
autochequeo: Are all six skills present, or did one crowd out the others?
Did the hedging survive once I had to think about content?
Is the feedback still actionable under all the softening?
Did I repeat the error I identified on Monday?
Did I use what Survival Week showed me was missing?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of six skills at once: summarising, hedging, advanced phrasal verbs, conversation management, clefts and constructive feedback. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Say which collapsed under the pressure of doing all six. (3) Give me one sentence that would have carried three of them at once. Correct nothing outside these six areas. ---
